versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 酒店聚合助手 (fb-hotel-aggregation-skill)
- Aggregates hotel data from multiple platforms: 分贝通、携程、美团、同程、华住会、锦江
- Provides unified hotel search, room type query, price comparison, and booking services
- Implements smart deduplication and displays best prices with source indication
- Ensures only real-time, source-provided data is used and clearly identifies data sources
